project: Mario Strikers Charged native PC build
approach: Static recompilation of the disc's own code on the player's PC; bring your own disc, no game files distributed.
notes: Plays a VS match at 60 fps, no graphics errors seen. Tested on the Linux mini PC by playing a match (60.0 fps, no frame over 20 ms in 45 s, with the disc on an SSD; from a hard disk there are hitches, as the game reads the disc during play) and on Windows 11 (with the current runtime version up to the team menus; a match with the version before). Nothing here says the game is playable to the end. Built with AI assistance (Claude).
